decisions.reason: The building digital twin service has shown no visible traction beyond a website mention, but industry growth and the firm's slack let it keep exploring this emerging field for another year.

The authentication delegation service overlaps with the Identity Service and is a candidate for consolidation, yet its low carrying cost and closeness to the core offer make withdrawal within the year less likely than not.
The open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and supports its project business, so it clearly meets aspirations.
The Identity Service was actively promoted and fits the strategic direction of integrating GIS with enterprise systems, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, builds on existing consulting know-how at low cost, and feeds project business, so management would keep it.
